title: HVAC Preventive Maintenance Inspection Checklist
subtitle: Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: HVAC Preventive Maintenance Inspection Checklist covers air handler, condenser, controls, distribution, and served zone. The facility maintenance coordinator records Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. HVAC Preventive Maintenance Inspection Checklist keeps Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance exceptions visible until the facility maintenance coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use HVAC Preventive Maintenance Inspection Checklist at equipment room, roof, mechanical area, and occupied zone. Document air handler, condenser, controls, distribution, and served zone identity before Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance begins. Compare air handler, condenser, controls, distribution, and served zone findings with stated Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance criteria; route unresolved Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance issues to qualified HVAC service supervisor. For HVAC Preventive Maintenance Inspection Checklist, confirm requirements for Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance. Ask qualified HVAC service supervisor to review Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance conditions beyond the facility maintenance coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspection scope and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance, identify responsible parties, equipment room, roof, mechanical area, and occupied zone, and the linked air handler, condenser, controls, distribution, and served zone source.

fields.label: Equipment tag, model, serial, and served area

sections.title: Checklist points, conditions, and actions
sections.guidance: Capture Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance facts for air handler, condenser, controls, distribution, and served zone; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

blocks.label: Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance inspection checks
items: Belt, bearing, fan, and motor condition
Supply and return temperature or airflow result
Coil, drain pan, trap, and condensate condition
Refrigerant-circuit visual condition and leak concern
Thermostat, sensor, alarm, and sequence response

sections.title: Inspection disposition and reviewer acknowledgment
sections.guidance: List each unresolved Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance finding with its restriction, correction owner, and reinspection trigger. Facility Maintenance Coordinator records reviewer disposition.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Refrigerant or combustion concern outside authorization
Blocked drainage or active water damage
Required capacity, alarm, or sequence not restored
blocks.guidance: Pause Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance when energy isolation, refrigerant concern, combustion concern, or failed operating safeguard remains unresolved. Retain the available Facility HVAC Preventive Maintenance proof and route unresolved air handler, condenser, controls, distribution, and served zone scope to facility maintenance coordinator.
